instruction_summary: Corrective study for the HHJK (2019) post-2010 living-update (001/002/003): report failed gates honestly (Gate 3b FAILED), pair L4/L4b under both deflator conventions and lead with the convention-robust absolute friction contribution, complete the dropped deliverables (LivingDefl L6, group_shares, L7/L2-young/L8-earn/L9-annual), make Gate 2b(ii) a real array check, recompute Gate 4 with script 04, rebuild tau_paths/fig1 from the Octave estimator, fix robustness_summary labels, and correct the 003 theory wording.

steps.description: Read provenance audit (authoritative fix list §8), spec, and prior 001/002/003 artifacts/reports/cards

Rebuilt venv (pandas/numpy/matplotlib/scipy/pyarrow); Octave 6.4.0 present; no gnuplot (install forbidden) so wrote no-op graphics shims so the numeric pipeline runs headless (verified meanlogtau byte-identical to prior run -> shims numerically clean)

FIX 1 Gate-3b level-scale sensitivity: re-ran Living S1-S3 + t6_7 c1 with 2023 earnings scaled 1/1.019 and 1/1.016 (+ reverse +1.9% and intermediate pce2010=104.0). tau-hat invariant (meanlogtau identical); L4 moves only via the growth denominator
FIX 3 LivingDefl L6: ran t6_7 chunks c3/c4/c5 (corrected-deflator group split) reusing existing .mat; filled group_shares.csv

FIX 4 Gate 2b(ii): dumped the ACTUAL TauW_alt/TauH_alt/Z_alt arrays from production how_much_poorer.m at t0=1970 and t0=2010 and diffed vs the rule (PASS), covering the t0>1 incumbent path L4 depends on
FIX 5 Gate 4: ran scripts/04 in-run; (a) 96.46% unambiguous/0% unmapped, (b) Duncan 0.0103 vs 0.0114, (c) group ratios 0.80-0.99 -> PASS; quantified R4 as argmax-split proxy (5/538 codes)

FIX 6 tau_paths/fig1/stability: rebuilt tau_paths.csv + fig1 from the Octave 'Mean(weighted)' estimator (BW 1960 7.90->6.685); verified raw tau-hat 1960-2010 identical 6v7 (max rel 4.6e-16) so the masked GetTExperience re-run is moot; added the t1=6 L3/L6 stability rows

deviations: Gate 3b is reported FAILED but the 2023 model results are retained (the spec's honest-partial path): the failure is the earnings LEVEL convention, which is quantified by the level-scale sensitivity (L4 6.1-8.4%, L5 invariant) rather than re-fetching data. This is a deliberate, disclosed departure from the literal stop rule, matching the audit's framing.

R4 'SPLIT' is relabeled (not re-run as a true fractional allocation): a true fractional SPLIT would require rebuilding the 2023 data pipeline; the honest relabel option permitted by the audit was taken, with the 5/538-code scope stated.

No gnuplot available and installs are forbidden, so Octave figures are stubbed with no-op graphics shims; all figures are re-plotted in Python per the spec. Numeric invariance verified (meanlogtau byte-identical).
003 theory corrections are written as results/003_theory_corrections.md and incorporated into card_corrections.csv rather than editing the read-only 003 directory.
